messages:
claudia: FYI telemetry spike on fncall schema rejections for product-search-adapter.
raj: on it. reject_count for strict-validate route jumped but invokes still flowed. looks like validator matched the wrong path.
kevin: can you paste an example payload and the failing jsonpath? helps diagnosis.
claudia: snippet + trace:
https://traces/redwood/def456
```json
{ "query": "office chairs", "tool_result": { "items": [] }, "items": [] }
```
kevin: ugh 14 the rule `$.items[*]` is ambiguous here and matches both locations. matcher picks first occurrence and flags invalid_shape even though tool payload was fine.
tori: so we get a reject metric on strict routes but billing shows token/invoke counted -> chargeback will be noisy.
raj: exactly. we end up double-attributing (rejects + invokes). Need to prevent metric inflation, and avoid spamming alerts.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling canary validator v2 -> canary-4
lucas: console change: we currently only show validation_code. can we attach `matched_jsonpath` + small payload preview to the validation event for triage?
kevin: short-term fix: make the validator prefer `fncall.tool` namespace if present (explicit disambiguation). fallback: require non-empty arrays for matching `[*]`.
claudia: I'll mute the alert for that rule for 60m while we push the hotfix.
raj: I'll open PR for the hotfix now and add a telemetry flag `parse_shadowing=true` sampled 10% for ambiguous hits so we can backfill with more context.
tori: also add a billing-delta monitor for route_tag=strict-validate to catch regressions post-rollout.
lucas: UI work: adding console column `matched_jsonpath_snippet` + 50-char payload preview in validation events. filing frontend ticket: https://issues/redwood/1289
kevin: runbook updates: note to check trace -> matched_jsonpath -> route_tag. add steps to mute and revert rule if billing delta > 1%.
incident-bot: created incident INC-2026-032 assigned to @raj
raj: deploying hotfix to validator canary now, will monitor sample logs for parse_shadowing=true.
claudia: thanks. once hotfix is stable can we add a lint to validator rules to avoid top-level ambiguous jsonpaths in new rules?
kevin: yes, adding a rule-linter in validator-config CI that flags `$.items[*]` when there are sibling keys with same name.
lucas: thanks all 44d I'll start the console filter PR and wire the telemetry column.
claudia: closing loop: I'll document the incident in the postmortem board and add the remediation checklist.
